scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @installall/web" "npm run dev -w @installall/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @installall/shared && npm run build -w @installall/api && npm run build -w @installall/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @installall/web && npm run lint -w @installall/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @installall/shared && npm run typecheck -w @installall/api && npm run typecheck -w @installall/web
